- Do you expect embeddings-heavy workloads or primarily generation/chat?
- Are you evaluating Dedicated or Hosted (public API) for the pilot?

If procurement prefers, we can send the NDA via DocuSign (see link below) and keep versioning in Drive so both teams have the same artifacts.

DocuSign (optional): https://redwood.app/docusign/NDAX-987654

Please share the rate sheet and an initial commercial note. Procurement prefers quote validity of 30 days.

Claire / Rajiv — great, thanks for the countersigned NDA. I’ve attached our baseline rate sheet for Hosted API (Rate_Sheet_Hosted_API_v1.0.pdf) and an updated NDA copy (Redwood_NDA_v1.1.pdf) that reflects a small procurement suggestion we normally accept (clarifies data handling duration).

Highlights from the rate sheet (v1.0):
- Baseline token generation price: $0.004 / 1k tokens
- Embeddings: $0.0009 / 1k tokens
- Volume tiers: 10% discount at 10M tokens/month, 15% at 25M+.
- Starter credit: $2,000 credit for first 90 days for pilots (applies once the pilot is onboarded).

We can provide a 15% committed-spend discount for annualized commitments > $250k. For the pilot you mentioned, I can propose a short-term introductory credit (we typically do 10% off billed tokens for the first 60–90 days) while we validate latency and integration.

Attachments: Rate_Sheet_Hosted_API_v1.0.pdf, Redwood_NDA_v1.1.pdf

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm whether you want the DocuSign copy of the NDA countersigned (I can send for formal countersignature).
2) I’ll produce a brief term-sheet/quote with the pilot pricing and validity window (30 days) once you confirm expected committed spend for months 4–12.
3) If procurement needs a PO template we can provide net-30 or net-45 options and sample SOW language.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call if Rajiv wants to walk the procurement team through the line items.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachments: Rate_Sheet_Hosted_API_v1.0.pdf, Redwood_NDA_v1.1.pdf]

Thanks Aditya — a couple of quick questions from procurement:
- For the pilot (months 1–3) can you put a starter discount on the per-token rate rather than a credit? That helps our internal chargeback reporting.
- Can you guarantee the quoted rates for 30 days from today?
- Any flexibility on a 3-month performance SLA for the pilot (target p95 latency under 300ms for generation)?

Also please include a short line item for an initial integration support block (10 hours) — we’d expect an SOW addendum for that. If you can provide a numbered quote we’ll route internally and should be able to return a PO within the 30-day window.

-Rajiv

Rajiv / Claire — appreciate the clarifying questions. Below is a concise response and next steps.

1) Starter discount vs credit: we can convert the $2,000 starter credit into a time-limited per-token starter discount for the pilot. Proposed pilot pricing (months 1–3): $0.0036 / 1k tokens (10% starter discount on generation) and $0.00081 / 1k for embeddings. I’ll reflect this in an updated rate sheet (v1.1).

2) Quote validity: we will mark the quote valid for 30 days from today (07/02/2026).

3) Pilot SLA: we can commit to a 3-month pilot p95 latency target of 300ms for generation on our Hosted API in the US region, with a service credit mechanism if we miss the target on more than 2 weekly checks. I’ve looped in Priyom for legal to ensure the SLA language maps to standard terms.

4) Integration support: I’ve added a 10-hour integration block as a billed line item at $250/hour in the updated term sheet.

Attached: Rate_Sheet_Hosted_API_v1.1.pdf (includes starter discount, discount tiers, and a short term-sheet row with monetary totals for a 6–12 month projection). I’ve also uploaded the signed NDA to DocuSign for our internal tracking.

Next steps:
- I’ll create a numbered quote (valid 30 days) and upload to the HubSpot deal (ID: REDW-789012) — please confirm the billing entity and PO contact and I’ll route the quote.
- If you confirm we’ll proceed, I can have a one-page SOW addendum and PO-ready quote within 48 hours.
